segments.text: Talk about the ultimate breakup. Europe and Africa have been splitting apart from the
American continents for millions of years. At a rate of approximately 2.5 centimeters per
year, the continents are moving about as fast as our fingernails grow, and as they continue
to split, the rift between them. Otherwise known as the Atlantic Ocean, we'll get even
wider. And all this drama is leaving behind a major scar. An underwater valley called
the mid-Atlantic ridge, which tears more and more as the continents slowly move apart.
Looking back on the continental relationship, puts us in mere 300 million years ago, when
